releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.2.4

- The first universal coaching sync now baselines every request already present in the private folder.
- Older files omitted from a stale legacy ledger cannot be processed as new approvals after an upgrade.
- Only requests added or changed after that safe baseline are eligible for processing.
- Includes the complete workout display, animated exercise links, legacy credential recognition, and safety-checked description corrections from 2.2.1–2.2.3.
